items.label: Oral Song-Lore
items.description: Generational memory and legal codes preserved solely through rhythmic ballads and skaldic epics.

items.label: Ancestor Veneration
items.description: Offerings of honey, wine, and smoke given to heroic forefathers who guard the hearth.

items.label: Sacred Burial Mounds
items.description: Constructing stone-lined earthen tumuli to honor fallen chieftains and mark clan territories.

items.label: Shamanic Totemism
items.description: Communion with beast and storm spirits that guide tribal hunts and warn of incoming disasters.

items.label: Starlight Navigation
items.description: Mapping desert dunes and trackless ocean tides by aligning voyaging craft to celestial star paths.

items.label: Harvest Festivals
items.description: Great communal feasts celebrating autumn yields with games of strength, dancing, and grain tributes.

items.label: Solar Calendar & Sun Dance
items.description: Tracking solstices through megalith alignments and performing endurance rites to welcome the dawn.

items.label: Sacred Hospitality (Xenia)
items.description: Ancient, inviolable taboo guaranteeing safe passage and refuge to guests who share bread and salt.

items.label: Blood Oaths & Brotherhood
items.description: Ceremonial mingling of blood forging unbreakable covenants between allied clan leaders and warriors.

items.label: Fire-Tending Rituals
items.description: Sacred hearth-keepers maintain continuous embers, strictly forbidding a cold hearth during winter.

items.label: Canopy Dwellers
items.description: Constructing rope bridges and timber treehouse villages high in the colossal redwood canopy.

items.label: Subterranean Delvers
items.description: Excavating multi-tiered stone warrens and mushroom galleries within living cavern bedrock.

items.label: Nomadic Steppe Herders
items.description: Following seasonal grazing herds across vast open grasslands with collapsible felt yurts.

items.label: Reef & Atoll Mariners
items.description: Diving for black pearls and spearing reef fish from outrigger canoes among tropical coral atolls.

items.label: Glacial Wayfarers
items.description: Crossing crevasse fields on bone crampons and building dome snow shelters during raging blizzards.

items.label: Symbiotic Grove-Kin
items.description: Cultivating sentient bioluminescent fungi that illuminate deep glens and purify tainted water.

items.label: Cliffside Pueblos
items.description: Carving multi-story stone and adobe dwellings into the shade of sheer canyon alcoves.

items.label: Oasis Caravan Havens
items.description: Nurturing freshwater palm springs that serve as vital crossroads for desert spice traders.
